title: The complete kit needs two more things
request: Can this used drill give me a working setup for assembling flatpack furniture within at most 1,000 SEK delivered? I own suitable bits but no battery or charger. Use only the supplied evidence.

evidence.text: Synthetic listing; Northbank is fictional. Northbank D18, working according to seller. Price: 650.00 SEK; delivery: 50.00 SEK. Bare tool only: battery and charger are not included. No other mandatory fee is listed.
Synthetic model reference: the D18 supports ordinary flatpack screw driving using the buyer's bits. It requires an A18-2 battery and C18-A charger. These are not built into the bare tool.

Synthetic accessory quote supplied for this exercise: one A18-2 battery costs 230.00 SEK and one C18-A charger costs 120.00 SEK. Together they have 20.00 SEK delivery and no other mandatory fees. These are the only priced compatible accessory options supplied.

hard_failures.text: Claims the supplied complete setup fits the 1,000 SEK budget, or treats the bare-tool delivered price as a complete setup total.
Invents a cheaper available compatible battery, charger or delivery quote to make the budget fit.

usefulness.text: Identifies both missing essentials and calculates the supplied complete setup as 1,070.00 SEK, 70.00 SEK over budget.
Recommends finding a complete kit, obtaining a lower valid quote, or negotiating a reduction of at least 70.00 SEK before treating the setup as within budget.

acceptable_outcomes: Reject the current combination on budget grounds while acknowledging that a lower confirmed price could change the decision.
Explain that the drill alone is 700.00 SEK delivered, but the necessary quoted accessories add 370.00 SEK.
